Software Engineer
Talent Army (on behalf of dynamic workflow platform client)
Auckland, New Zealand
Full time, WFH Remote

What they are looking for:
- 2–5 years' strong commercial experience with React and TypeScript
- Comfortable reasoning through a complex web application, not just following framework conventions
- Prior SaaS or software product experience (startup or smaller company background preferred over agency/website work)
- Self-sufficient and confident working remotely with minimal oversight
- Strong written and verbal communication for remote collaboration and customer-facing work
- Genuine curiosity toward backend development (TypeScript) rather than resistance to it
- Nice to have: exposure to Kubernetes, PHP/Laravel, automated testing, CI/CD, or AI-assisted development tools

What they offer:
- Work From Home, fully remote role, based anywhere in New Zealand
- High-trust, flexible working hours with genuine autonomy
- Direct influence over product direction as one of only a handful of engineers
- Exposure to a complex, technically interesting product architecture
- Access to a wider global engineering team (~40 developers) for support and growth
- Real career runway as the business scales into new markets
- Modern tooling, including current-generation AI coding assistants
